description: Generate the same prompt in multiple styles for side-by-side comparison. Creates individual images and an optional comparison grid. Great for choosing the best style for your project.

grid.description: Generate a comparison grid image (default: true)

model.description: Model to use (V3 recommended for style support)

prompt.description: Image description to test across styles

size.description: Image size (e.g., 1024x1024, 1344x768) or ratio (e.g., 16:9, 1:1 for vector models)

styles.description: Array of style names to compare (e.g., ["digital_illustration", "pixel_art", "vector_art"])

name: recraft_compare_styles
